items.summary: Prime Minister Sergii Koretskyi said Wednesday on Telegram that overnight Russian strikes killed four people and hit energy facilities in the Kyiv, Volyn, Odesa and Mykolaiv regions. Kyiv mayor Klitschko reported a Russian drone hit a transport infrastructure facility in the Solomianskyi district (fire) plus drone debris in several other districts. In Kharkiv region, two elderly residents (81 and 83) were killed in a drone attack on Korotych village, with 11 more affected including two children (Syniehubov; Kyiv Independent). In Poltava region, a drone hit a Kremenchuk university building (3 injured, incl. a 16-year-old) and fires broke out at an administrative building and a storage facility in Poltava city. Russia's Defence Ministry claimed its drones hit a cargo vessel carrying military cargo to Odesa, a drone-storage warehouse in Poltava, and an electric power substation in Kyiv - hours before US envoy Witkoff's St. Petersburg meeting with Putin.
items.title: Overnight Oct 20-21 Russian strikes hit energy facilities in four regions, 4 killed
